title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China (III)

articles.content_en: Article 2 Where the insured notifies the insurer and the applicant in writing that he or she revokes the expression of consent made pursuant to the provisions of paragraph 1 of Article 34 of the Insurance Law, it may be determined that the insurance contract is dissolved.

Article 3 When a People's Court tries a dispute over a personal insurance contract, it shall proactively examine whether the applicant has an insurable interest at the time of concluding the insurance contract, and whether the insured has consented to and ratified the insured amount in respect of a contract with death as the condition for payment of insurance money.

Article 4 After the conclusion of an insurance contract, where a party claims that the insurance contract is void on the ground that the applicant has lost the insurable interest in the insured, the People's Court shall not support such claim.

Article 5 Where, at the time of conclusion of the insurance contract, the insured undergoes a physical examination at a designated medical service institution at the request of the insurer, and a party claims that the applicant's obligation of truthful disclosure is exempted, the People's Court shall not support such claim.
Where the insurer, knowing the results of the insured's physical examination, still demands dissolution of the contract on the ground that the applicant failed to perform the obligation of truthful disclosure with respect to the relevant circumstances, the People's Court shall not support such demand.

Article 6 Where a person other than the parents of a minor who performs guardianship duties concludes for the minor a contract with death as the condition for payment of insurance money, and a party claims that the contract shall be determined valid by reference to the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 33 and paragraph 3 of Article 34 of the Insurance Law, the People's Court shall not support such claim, unless the parents of the minor have consented.

Article 7 Where a party claims, on the ground that the insured, the beneficiary, or another person has already paid the insurance premium on behalf of the applicant, that the corresponding payment obligation of the applicant has been performed, the People's Court shall support such claim.

Article 8 Where the validity of an insurance contract is suspended in accordance with the provisions of Article 36 of the Insurance Law, and the applicant applies for reinstatement of validity and agrees to pay the insurance premium retroactively, if the insurer refuses to reinstate the validity, the People's Court shall not support such refusal unless the insured's degree of risk has significantly increased during the suspension period.
Where the insurer, within thirty days after receiving the application for reinstatement, does not expressly refuse, it shall be determined that the insurer agrees to reinstate the validity.
The insurance contract shall be reinstated on the date when the applicant pays the insurance premium retroactively. Where the insurer requires the applicant to pay corresponding interest, the People's Court shall support such requirement.

Article 10 Where the applicant or the insured changes the beneficiary, and a party claims that the change takes effect from the time when the declaration of intention to change is made, the People's Court shall support such claim.
Where the applicant or the insured changes the beneficiary without notifying the insurer, and the insurer claims that the change is not effective against it, the People's Court shall support such claim.
Where the applicant changes the beneficiary without the consent of the insured, the People's Court shall determine that the change is invalid.

Article 11 Where the applicant or the insured changes the beneficiary after the occurrence of the insured event, and the beneficiary after the change requests the insurer to pay insurance money, the People's Court shall not support such request.

Article 13 After the occurrence of the insured event, where the beneficiary transfers to a third party all or part of the claim for insurance money corresponding to the insured event, and a party claims that the transfer is valid, the People's Court shall support such claim, unless the claim is not transferable according to the nature of the contract, the agreement of the parties, or the provisions of law.

Article 14 Where the insurance money is regarded as the estate of the insured according to the provisions of Article 42 of the Insurance Law, and the heirs of the insured request the insurer to pay insurance money, if the insurer defends on the ground that it has already paid insurance money to other heirs of the insured who hold the insurance policy, the People's Court shall support such defense.

Article 15 Where the beneficiary and the insured have a succession relationship, and they die in the same event and the order of their deaths cannot be determined, the People's Court shall, in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 42 of the Insurance Law, presume that the beneficiary died first, and shall determine the ownership of the insurance money according to the relevant provisions of the Insurance Law and this Interpretation.

Article 16 Where, at the time of dissolution of the insurance contract, the applicant, the insured, and the beneficiary are different persons, and the insured or the beneficiary requests the refund of the cash value of the insurance policy, the People's Court shall not support such request, unless otherwise agreed in the insurance contract.
Where the applicant intentionally causes the death, disability, or disease of the insured, and the insurer refunds the cash value of the insurance policy in accordance with the provisions of Article 43 of the Insurance Law, the other entitled persons shall be determined in the order of the insured and then the heirs of the insured.

Article 17 Where the applicant dissolves the insurance contract, and a party claims that the dissolution is invalid on the ground that it was made without the consent of the insured or the beneficiary, the People's Court shall not support such claim, unless the insured or the beneficiary has paid to the applicant an amount equivalent to the cash value of the insurance policy and notified the insurer.

Article 18 Where the insurer, when paying expense-reimbursement medical expense insurance money, claims to deduct the amount of compensation received by the insured from public medical care or social medical insurance, it shall prove that, when the premium rate for the medical expense insurance product was determined, the portion corresponding to public medical care or social medical insurance had already been deducted accordingly, and that the insurance premium was collected according to the standard after deduction.

Article 19 Where an insurance contract stipulates that medical expenses shall be verified according to the standards of basic medical insurance, and the insurer refuses to pay insurance money on the ground that the insured's medical expenses exceed the scope of basic medical insurance, the People's Court shall not support such refusal; where the insurer has evidence proving that the expenses incurred by the insured exceed the standard for similar medical expenses under basic medical insurance, and requests to refuse to pay insurance money for the excess portion, the People's Court shall support such request.

Article 20 Where the insurer refuses to pay insurance money on the ground that the insured did not receive treatment at a medical service institution stipulated in the insurance contract, the People's Court shall support such refusal, unless the insured had to seek immediate medical treatment because of an emergency.

Article 21 Where the insurer refuses to pay insurance money on the ground that the insured committed suicide, the insurer shall bear the burden of adducing evidence.
Where the beneficiary or the heirs of the insured defend on the ground that the insured had no capacity for civil conduct at the time of suicide, they shall bear the burden of adducing evidence.

Article 22 The determination of an "intentional crime committed by the insured" as provided for in Article 45 of the Insurance Law shall be based on effective legal documents or other conclusive opinions of the criminal investigation authorities, procuratorial authorities, and adjudication authorities.

Article 23 Where the insurer claims that it shall not bear the liability to pay insurance money according to the provisions of Article 45 of the Insurance Law, it shall prove that there is a causal relationship between the death or disability of the insured and the intentional crime committed by the insured or his or her act of resisting criminal compulsory measures taken according to law.
Where the insured suffers disability or death due to an accident or disease while in custody or serving a sentence, and the insurer claims that it shall not bear the liability to pay insurance money according to the provisions of Article 45 of the Insurance Law, the People's Court shall not support such claim.

Article 24 Where the applicant concludes for the insured an insurance contract with death as the condition for payment of insurance money, and after the insured is declared dead, a party requests the insurer to pay insurance money in accordance with the terms of the insurance contract, the People's Court shall support such request.
Where the date on which the insured is declared dead is outside the insurance liability period, but there is evidence proving that the date on which the insured's whereabouts became unknown is within the insurance liability period, and a party requests the insurer to pay insurance money in accordance with the terms of the insurance contract, the People's Court shall support such request.

Article 25 Where it is difficult to determine whether the loss of the insured was caused by an insured event, a non-insured event, or an exempted cause, and a party requests the insurer to pay insurance money, the People's Court may support the request according to the corresponding proportion.

Article 26 This Interpretation shall come into force on December 1, 2015. This Interpretation shall apply to cases involving disputes over insurance contracts that have not yet been finally adjudicated after this Interpretation comes into force; this Interpretation shall not apply to cases that have already been finally adjudicated before this Interpretation comes into force, where a party applies for a retrial or a retrial is decided in accordance with the trial supervision procedure.
